title: refactor: simplify realtime configuration and request handling
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Shares realtime model metadata, cached-modality billing adjustments, token-cost tables, and one WebSocket session harness.
- Centralizes credential query redaction for logger and realtime telemetry, including `apikey` and `bearerToken` aliases.
- Preserves model IDs, prices, billing counters, request flow, telemetry fields, invalid-referrer handling, and non-credential query parameters.
- Waits for mocked telemetry before the consolidated test helper reads it, preventing leaked session settlement during test teardown.
- Removes 253 net lines across six files and supersedes #12915 and #12929.

Checks:
- 54/54 affected Worker tests: realtime, error observability, and safety
- Gen TypeScript typecheck
- Biome 2.3.10 on all six changed files
- Exact normalized comparison of realtime registry and billing outputs against `main`
- Credential-redaction alias, duplicate-parameter, immutability, and safe-URL matrix
- `git diff --check origin/main...HEAD`

gist.headline: One hive, fewer wires
gist.blurb: Realtime plumbing has been gathered into one tidy little nest. Same model routes and billing behavior, with fewer places for configuration to wander off.
gist.summary: Centralized realtime model metadata, cached-modality billing adjustments, token-cost tables, WebSocket session handling, and credential-query redaction across the Gen Worker’s realtime paths.
gist.impact: Realtime requests retain the same model IDs, prices, counters, telemetry fields, referrer handling, and query parameters while the shared implementation is easier to keep consistent.
gist.visual_concept: Polli tidies several tangled realtime WebSocket cables into one shared glowing registry cabinet, while a CRT monitor robot watches the same signals flow cleanly through labeled pipes. Small code-plants and flowers represent the consolidated shared metadata and billing tables.
